description:
Operational health for a date range: fulfillment velocity (payment→submit→ship→deliver averages), order counts, and cancellation / refund / hold rates, plus a hold-reason breakdown. Requires an Advanced Analytics plan. Read-only.

[#ed8ddd]

currency.description: Reporting currency (e.g. "USD"). Currencies are segmented, never summed.

end.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit to default to today (UTC).

start.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit to default to 30 days before end.

store.description: Store uuid to narrow to one store. Omit for all accessible stores.

workspace.description: Workspace uuid to scope to (agency accounts). Omit for the Default workspace.

name: analytics_ops
